Archive a Time Off Type

User manual · English · 8 steps
Learn how to archive a time off type that is no longer used, so employees can no longer request it.

1. Open Time Off

Open the Time Off app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Time Off Types

Click Time Off Types.

4. Find the time off type

Type the name of the time off type and press Enter.

5. Select it

Tick the box in front of the time off type.

6. Actions

Click Actions.

7. Archive

Click Archive.

8. Confirm

Click Archive in the window to confirm.
